policy.basis: output/market_backtest_summary.json + output/policy_analysis.json (BettingPros closing archive 2022wk10-2025). lam: dev log-loss best 0.20, dev MAE best 0.55, chosen 0.35 as the compromise (2025 log-loss best was also 0.35 - chosen with 2025 visible, so treat as mildly optimistic). dead_zone 1.5 attempts: dev per-|gap| bins showed no model information below 1.5; held on 2025. Side rule rejected: overs won in dev, unders in 2025.
policy.review_after: 100 settled ledger decisions or 2026 week 8, whichever first

adaptations: Shared canonical event/player identity and paired full-game pregame offers; same observation clock as champion.
Shared 30-minute observation/24-hour known quote update checks; current paired spread/total required.
Shared independently verified active starter, injury and context freshness gates; these are adapter rules, not Claude policy.
Selected ridge base refits on causally rebuilt completed-game features, including new seasons; no candidate or policy reselection.
Original saved residual pool and EB corrections remain frozen. Original fit_only residual-update routine is not used.
Original market center includes the target book and all offered lines; identical book/line observations are deduplicated.
